title: Three victims of Isle of Wight helicopter crash named
summary: Justyna Czoska, a horse riding instructor, and her partner, Wojtek Kowalkowski, died along with Simon Hewitt A couple who died in a helicopter crash on the Isle of Wight during the bank holiday have been named by relatives. Justyna Czoska, 52, a horse riding instructor, and her partner, Wojtek Kowalkowski, 49, of Bloxham, Oxfordshire, died after the aircraft crash-landed at about 9.24am on Monday between Shanklin and Whiteley Bank. The helicopter had taken off from Sandown airport 20 minutes earlier, the operator said. Continue reading...
